text: S585 hash-checked 14 existing C:-only artifacts and reviewed the saved Standard DXF render. S584's pre-export getter remains semantically/stage ambiguous. CLO 2026.1.310 is closed as a candidate for these tested configurations only, not as a general CLO/DXF incompatibility claim.
